categories.description: Terms and phrases related to facial detail.

entries.description: A small animal muzzle-nose on the face.
A youthful soft face with large eyes, a small nose, and rounded childish cheeks.
A strikingly attractive face rendered with fine detail, luminous eyes, and flawless skin.
A bruise on the face.
A cheek pushed out from inside.
A fingertip pressed into a cheek.
A cheek pressed flat against something.
The face renders with crisp high-resolution features, sharp eyes, and defined skin texture.
Smudges of dirt on the face.
Every facial feature sharpens into near-photographic detail from iris fibers to lip texture.
A bruise on the face.
A drawn mark on the face.
A lovely face drawn with meticulous fine detail, delicate shading, and polished highlights.
A small mole above the lip.
A small mole below the lip.
The nose is the noted feature.
A swollen rounded face with padded cheeks and slightly distended soft features.
The face flushed a deep purple.
A soft circular face shape with full cheeks and a gently rounded jawline.
A healed mark on the body; a stable identity detail rather than a temporary state.
A scar on the cheek.
A scar on the face.
A narrow, elongated face shape with delicate cheekbones and a tapered jawline.
The face renders small and delicate relative to the head and body, an anime beauty ideal.
The face renders at extreme fidelity, showing skin texture, individual lashes, and iris reflections.
The face drawn inverted.
Draws the brows clearly above the eyes as distinct shaped hair rather than hiding them under the fringe.
A painted or tattooed mark centered on the forehead, from a single dot to an ornate design.
Bangs fall low enough to cover the eyebrows completely, hiding them behind opaque hair.
A round empty hole where the face should be, the features replaced by a dark opening.
Eyebrows drawn with visible thickness in a color clearly different from the hair.
A deliberately plain face with minimal simple features, like an anonymous background figure.
A face drawn with no nose at all, the cheeks and mouth meeting over smooth blank skin.
Both cheeks bulge out round and full, packed with food or held air.
Eyebrows lifted only at their inner ends, peaking above the nose in a pleading look.
A head left with almost no features at all, the face reading as blank empty space.
A face longer than it is wide with balanced forehead and jaw width and softly rounded edges, producing a gently elongated oval outline.
A face with similar width and length, full cheeks, and a curved jaw, producing a soft circular outline.
A face with a broad forehead, strong wide jaw, and relatively straight sides, producing an angular box-like outline.
A face with a broad forehead and cheek area tapering to a narrow pointed chin, producing a heart-like outline.
A face whose vertical length clearly exceeds its width, producing an elongated appearance without requiring a particular jaw shape.
A long face with fairly even width and softened forehead and chin contours, producing an elongated rounded outline.
A long face with straight sides, a broad forehead, and an angular jaw, producing an elongated rectangular outline.
A face with wide high cheekbones and a narrower forehead and chin, producing an angular diamond-like outline.
A face with a narrower forehead and a broader jaw or lower face, producing an upward-pointing triangular outline.
A face with a broad upper region that tapers steadily to a narrow chin, producing a downward-pointing triangular outline.
A face with a slim forehead, fuller cheeks, and a broad soft jaw, producing a pear-like outline weighted toward the lower face.
A face combining broad square-like proportions with fuller cheeks and a rounded jaw, producing a softened square outline.
A face combining a broad structured upper face with a softer tapered jaw, producing a hybrid square and oval outline.

categories.name: Expressions: Joy and Smiles
categories.description: Terms and phrases related to expressions: joy and smiles.

entries.description: A wide open laughing mouth with a big D-shaped grin and squeezed-shut happy eyes.
A deep roaring laugh with the head back and one hand slapped on the stomach.
Laughter erupts abruptly with the head thrown back, mouth wide, and body shaking.
A lively beaming expression full of energy, with bright eyes and an open grin.
Uncontrollable laughter doubles the figure over with streaming eyes and a gaping mouth.
A wicked scheming grin with narrowed eyes and sharp shadowed features.
A light suppressed laugh with a hand near the mouth and squeezed happy eyes.
Overwhelming delight with a wide open smile, shining eyes, and often raised arms.
A smile with the mouth open enough to show teeth, often with lifted cheeks and bright or crinkled eyes.
Only one corner of the mouth curls upward in a quiet knowing expression.
A broad genuine smile with raised cheeks and warm crinkled eyes.
The mouth opens wide in laughter with the head tilting back and eyes crinkling.
A sudden laugh escapes with the mouth open and shoulders shaking in amusement.
A mild contented smile with relaxed eyes and a settled satisfied expression.
The mouth lifts into a gentle newly formed smile, eyes warming to match.
The mouth curves upward softly with relaxed warm eyes and lifted cheeks.
A lopsided smile with one brow raised and a self-satisfied gleam in the eyes.
A grin under V-shaped brows, a rough bully's smile.
An explosive open-mouthed laugh with the head thrown back and tears of laughter.
The lips curve upward gently while staying sealed, showing no teeth.
A too-wide manic grin with wild staring eyes and an unhinged gleam.
A wide villainous grin baring teeth beneath glinting malicious eyes.
A cruel cold smile with narrowed eyes and an unmistakable air of menace.
A strained unconvincing smile that never reaches the flat cold eyes.
A fingertip hooks the corner of the mouth, pulling it up into a forced smile.
A coerced smile, slightly unnatural, sometimes with a hand gripping the face.
A barely held laugh, with a hand at the cheek.
Cuts or scars extend from the corners of the mouth up the cheeks, creating the appearance of an unnaturally extended smile.
A wide smile where the upper gum shows prominently above the teeth.
A bright pleased expression with upturned mouth corners and softly crinkled smiling eyes.
Tears stream from the eyes while the mouth smiles in overwhelming joy.
The head tips back with the mouth wide open and eyes squeezed shut in mirth.
A faint subtle upturn of the lips, barely lifting the mouth corners.
A mischievous grin with a playful glint and one brow raised in scheming.
A strained smile with raised brows and flying sweatdrops.
A smile with the mouth open.
A predatory leering grin with narrowed lustful eyes and a menacing expression of sexual intent.
A slow knowing smile with heavy-lidded eyes and a teasing tilt of the head.
The upper face falls into dark shadow, leaving only the smile or eyes visible beneath.
A cold threatening smile with shadowed eyes and cruelly upturned lips.
An anime-styled figure with a dark creepy grin, glinting eye highlight, and ominous shadowed face.
A smile with the eyes shut.
A self-satisfied expression with half-lidded eyes and a small superior curl of the lips.
A suppressed laugh; weak.
A gum-only smile with no visible teeth, typical of the very young or old.
A broad smile baring a full row of upper and lower teeth.
A mischief grin that turns the face into a troll.
The mouth stretches broad across the face with teeth showing and cheeks lifted.
Overwhelming bliss on the face, the eyes unfocused or rolled up and the mouth slack with joy.
Blissful rapture while eating, the eyes shut, head tilted, and one hand pressed to the cheek.
Warm, softened eyes and a sincere, gentle smile convey heartfelt appreciation.

entries.description: A lifted chin, bright eyes, and a pleased closed-mouth smile show satisfaction in an achievement.

entries.description: The chin rises above a self-satisfied smile while the eyes gleam with confident self-regard.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-joy-and-smiles because the expression centers on pleased self-regard.

entries.description: A broad, exultant smile and blazing, confident eyes celebrate success.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-joy-and-smiles because triumph is shown as exultant pleasure.

entries.description: The face lifts with a jubilant grin and bright, assured eyes that savor a win.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-joy-and-smiles because victory is shown through jubilant pleasure.

entries.description: A lively grin, sparkling eyes, and an impish brow give the face a lighthearted readiness for fun.

entries.description: A lopsided, toothy grin and unfocused or crossed eyes create an endearingly ridiculous expression.

categories.name: Expressions: Anger
categories.description: Terms and phrases related to expressions: anger.

entries.description: Irritation shows in a slight frown, a twitching brow, and a sidelong glance.
Fury consumes the face with bulging eyes, bared teeth, and shaking anger marks.
The mouth pulls downward at both corners beneath a lowered brow in displeasure.
Rage distorts the face with blazing eyes, bared teeth, and shaking tension.
The expression shifts into open irritation, brows dropping and mouth tightening mid-outburst.
Eyes fix in a hard hostile stare beneath lowered, heavily angled brows.
The face twists into a distorted scowl with bared teeth and wrinkled features.
Uncontrollable fury contorts the face with wide bloodshot eyes and a screaming mouth.
A dark hostile expression with deeply furrowed brows and a twisted mouth.
The lips pull back over bared teeth in an animalistic hostile curl.
The upper lip curls upward on one side in contemptuous scorn.
Overwhelming fury blazes across the face, often with glowing eyes and bulging rage veins.
A bulging cross-shaped vein mark pops out on the forehead or temple in fury.
A furious expression with sharply angled brows, gritted teeth, and tensed features.
A doubtful, slightly V-browed look.
Teeth clenched, for anger or a fierce grin.
The jaw locks with teeth grinding shut and brows lowered in barely contained fury.
Wide-eyed manic laughter, often horror-like.
Contempt, a step past disappointed.
Open disgust with the upper face shadowed and a glare.
The nose wrinkles and the mouth twists down in revolted rejection.
Jealousy; tends to summon a green-themed character by association.
A dark, corrupted expression with lowered saturation.
The nostrils widen and flare open in a sharp angry breath.
Discontent with knitted brows and a downturned mouth.
Deep creases gather between the drawn-down eyebrows in anger or concentration.
A sneering, contemptuous face like smirk or evil smile, losing cuteness.
A hostile glare at the viewer, serious rather than comic; near scowl and frown.
The head tilts back with the mouth open wide in a long wolf-like cry.
Hot irritation burns in a flushed face with steeply angled brows and gritted teeth.
Envy clouds the face with a tight forced smile and narrowed glaring eyes.
The figure gazes down at another with contempt, chin lifted and eyes half-lidded.
The figure shouts or chatters loudly with a gaping mouth and exaggerated expression.
The lips push forward in an exaggerated sulk, often with inflated cheeks.
One brow arches high while the other stays level in skepticism.
The mouth stretches wide open with tense neck muscles and squeezed-shut eyes.
A hard unmoved expression with level brows, a set jaw, and an unsmiling mouth.
A comic sulk with pout and sigh.
A brooding resentful expression with a downturned mouth and half-lidded grudging eyes.
A flat deadpan expression with half-lidded eyes and an unimpressed level mouth.
Both brows angle steeply down toward the nose in the classic V-shaped anger mark.
The face flinches with one eye squeezed shut and a twisted pained grimace.
The chin lifts as the eyes narrow and one side of the upper lip curls in scornful dismissal.

entries.description: A mocking or contemptuous expression curls the upper lip and twists the smile while the eyes narrow in scorn.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because the sneer is a hostile expression of contempt.
Meaning checked against the canonical e621 sneer wiki: https://e621.net/wiki_pages/sneer.

entries.description: An angry, pronounced frown draws the brows down and together while the eyes harden into a glare.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because a scowl is an angry frowning expression.
Meaning checked against the canonical e621 scowl wiki: https://e621.net/wiki_pages/scowl.

entries.description: The mouth turns down or tightens and the eyebrows draw inward, indicating disapproval, displeasure, or concentration.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger for its displeasure reading, while retaining the established concentration sense.
Meaning checked against the canonical e621 frown wiki: https://e621.net/wiki_pages/frown.

entries.description: A small, tight frown and narrowed eyes beneath lowered brows show impatience and rising annoyance.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because irritation is a restrained form of anger.

entries.description: The brows pinch, the eyes roll or close briefly, and the mouth tightens around a frustrated sigh.

entries.description: A hard, fixed glare, lowered brows, and a tightly set mouth communicate open antagonism.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because hostility is expressed as open antagonism.

entries.description: The eyes bore forward beneath sharply lowered brows while the jaw sets or the teeth bare for confrontation.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because the expression is confrontational and threatening.

entries.description: A cold stare and a tight, deliberate mouth make the character appear ready to cause harm.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because the expression communicates hostile intent.

entries.description: An unflinching gaze, lowered brows, and a firmly controlled mouth give the face a dominating, frightening force.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because intimidation is conveyed through hostile dominance.

entries.description: Narrowed eyes and a slow, cruel smile or rigid frown create an unmistakable sense of impending danger.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because menace conveys hostile, dangerous intent.

entries.description: The brows lower into rigid lines above an unyielding stare and a firmly compressed mouth.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger alongside the existing stern entry because severity reads as harsh, stern displeasure.

entries.description: A resentful sideways glare and a tight, unhappy mouth reveal bitter longing for what another has.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger beside the existing envy entry because the expression centers on resentful bitterness.

entries.description: The eyes fix greedily on the desired thing while the mouth tightens with acquisitive longing.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger beside envy because covetousness carries a resentful, grasping edge.

entries.description: A simmering glare and pressed, downturned lips hold onto a sense of injury and bitterness.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because resentment is sustained, bitter anger.

entries.description: The mouth twists into a sour half-smile or frown while the eyes harden with lingering resentment.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because bitterness is shown through resentful hostility.

entries.description: A narrow, malicious smile and cold eyes suggest a deliberate wish to hurt or inconvenience someone.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because spite is expressed through petty malice.

entries.description: A hard, satisfied smile and a fixed, unforgiving gaze reveal a desire for revenge.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because vindictiveness is vengeful hostility.

entries.description: A cruel, deliberate smile and glinting eyes convey pleasure in intended harm.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because malice is shown as hostile intent to harm.

entries.description: The mouth curls with cold amusement while the eyes remain hard and pitiless.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because cruelty reads as pitiless hostile intent.

entries.description: Bared teeth, flared nostrils, and a fierce glare make the face look brutally aggressive and untamed.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because savagery is conveyed as brutal aggression.

entries.description: A snarling mouth and intensely narrowed eyes beneath lowered brows give the face a violent, threatening force.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-anger because ferocity is shown as violent aggression.

categories.name: Expressions: Sadness and Distress
categories.description: Terms and phrases related to expressions: sadness and distress.

entries.description: Fear shrinks the figure with wide frightened eyes, raised brows, and a trembling mouth.
Loud uncontrolled crying with the mouth wide open and heavy tears flying.
Tears stream down a scrunched face with eyes squeezed shut and mouth open in a wail.
Discomfort shows in a strained expression with a nervous sweat drop and wavering eyes.
A hurt distressed look with glistening eyes, a bitten lip, and lowered brows.
A lamenting face that turned horror-like; gloom_(expression) is the usable version.
Deep torment twists the face with clenched teeth, streaming tears, and trembling features.
Worry knits the brows with darting eyes, a bitten lip, and fidgeting hands.
Both eyes squeeze shut while tears stream steadily down the cheeks.
Crying harder than tears, tears from both corners, grief-stricken.
Tears with the eyes wide open.
The figure takes on a shadowed sinister air with darkened eyes and an ominous atmosphere.
A hollow lifeless expression with dull half-lidded eyes, slumped shoulders, and shadowed features.
Despair: the light leaves the eyes, the face shades, and saturation drops.
Utter desolation collapses the expression into hollow eyes, tears, and clawing hands.
Deflated expectation shows in a dropped gaze, lowered brows, and a flat small frown.
Fear shakes the figure with wide glassy eyes, a trembling mouth, and a recoiling posture.
Tears scattered in the air beside the eyes, an illustrative flourish.
Sweat drops flung into the air, a comic sign of fluster; negative it when an expression tag adds it.
A gloomy, comic dread with vertical lines and shadow over the face.
Glowing tears with glowing eyes; white glowing tears keeps them from taking the eye colour.
A remorseful expression with downcast eyes, a lowered head, and a tight ashamed mouth.
Empty exhausted eyes stare out beneath a slack mouth, all hope drained from the face.
Shock and revulsion stretch the eyes wide and drain the face of color.
More a mood than an expression: a sunken blank face with a desolate background; sad for the face alone.
Solemn bereavement settles over the face with downcast eyes and a distant grieving gaze.
Anxious tension shows in wide uneasy eyes, a strained smile, and visible sweat drops.
Cold sweat with a frightened or troubled expression.
A pained expression, sometimes with injury and blood; negative blood for pain without wounds.
Wide frantic eyes, an open mouth, and flailing hands show sudden panic.
A hopeless downcast expression with drooping eyes and a defeated slight frown.
A rueful sorry expression with downcast eyes and a bitter twisted half-smile.
A frustrated, regretful face with drawn brows and a small downturned mouth.
Revulsion twists the face with a wrinkled nose, flared nostrils, and a turned-away head.
A downturned mouth and watery glistening eyes beneath a slumped deflated posture.
The mouth smiles gently while the eyes stay wet and sorrowful.
Terror widens the eyes and shrinks the pupils, with a shrinking guarded posture.
A small red-nosed intake of breath with glassy eyes in quiet subdued sadness.
Heaving cries shake the shoulders with eyes shut tight and heavy tears streaming.
Deep grief hangs in drooping eyes, a downturned mouth, and a bowed head.
Beads of sweat drawn beautifully; sparkles may intrude.
A single sweat drop inside a speech bubble, with a troubled face.
Tears running down in lines.
A single large translucent sweat bead slides down the temple, signaling awkwardness or stress.
Sweat-soaked clothing with a bra showing through, post-exercise, often with heavy breathing.
Tears well up and cling to the lower lashes, threatening to spill over.
Tears welling at the corners without falling; tears overflow, streaming tears run in lines.
Tears from one eye only; weak.
Eyes glisten with pooled unshed tears, shimmering and slightly reddened.
The brows knit upward and inward in a pained worried arch.
A face gone pale with fear; negative blue face if the skin turns blue.
Drenched in sweat, often with heavy breathing and steaming body.
A small trembling frown quivers with glassy brimming eyes and a shaking lip.
Wiping sweat from the face; holding towel adds a towel.
Wiping tears with a hand or handkerchief.
Concern creases the brow with downturned mouth corners and uneasy searching eyes.
Fear and helplessness in the face, brows pulled up, eyes wide, the mouth wavering.
A hollow shaken stare with shrunken pupils and a slack mouth in the wake of something horrifying.
The gaze falls away beneath pinched inner brows while the mouth tightens and the cheeks flush with self-reproach.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because shame reads as painful self-reproach.

entries.description: A remorseful, downcast gaze and a small, tense frown show awareness of having done wrong.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress beside the existing guilt entry because guilt reads as remorseful distress.

entries.description: The face burns with a deep flush as the eyes avoid contact and the mouth twists in mortified shame.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because humiliation is acute social distress.

entries.description: A dark, inward-looking stare and a heavy, downturned mouth suggest prolonged unhappy thought.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because brooding is sustained, gloomy rumination.

entries.description: Drooping eyelids, a distant gaze, and a faint downturned mouth give the face a quiet, lingering sadness.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because melancholy is a subdued sadness.

entries.description: The brows collapse upward at the center, the eyes fill or stream with tears, and the mouth trembles in bereavement.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because grieving is the expression of bereavement.

entries.description: A solemn, bowed face with downcast eyes and a closed, heavy mouth conveys sustained sorrow for a loss.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because mourning centers on sorrow for a loss.

entries.description: The eyes dull or water, the brows sag, and the mouth pulls down in thorough unhappiness.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because misery is deep unhappiness.

entries.description: Deep inner conflict twists the brows and mouth while the eyes look anguished, desperate, or haunted.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because torment is severe emotional suffering.

entries.description: The inner brows lift and pinch, the eyes widen or water, and the mouth wavers under visible emotional strain.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because the term directly names emotional distress.

entries.description: The brows draw together with raised inner corners as a soft, worried gaze and small frown show care about a problem.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because concern is expressed as worried unease.

entries.description: A clouded gaze, knitted brows, and a pressed, uneasy mouth show persistent worry or inner conflict.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because the expression centers on worry and inner conflict.

entries.description: The eyes shift warily and the brows tense while the mouth holds a small, uncomfortable frown.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because unease is anxious discomfort.

entries.description: The jaw tightens, the lips press together, and the eyes stay rigidly focused under visible strain.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because the facial tension communicates emotional strain.

entries.description: Knitted brows, tired or darting eyes, and a tight mouth make the character look burdened by pressure.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because stress appears as pressure and emotional strain.

entries.description: The eyes widen or fill as the brows pinch and the mouth falls open or trembles under more emotion than the character can manage.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress for the distressed reading of being emotionally overloaded.

entries.description: An upsetting surprise leaves the character speechless or motionless, often with bulging eyes, a fixed stare, or a dropped jaw.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because the established tag combines surprise with being upset.
Meaning checked against the e621 shocked wiki: https://e621.net/wiki_pages/shocked.

entries.description: A grave, unsmiling mouth and steady, lowered eyes give the face serious emotional weight.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because solemnity is shown as grave, restrained seriousness.

entries.description: The brows settle heavily over a sober gaze and the mouth closes in earnest, unsmiling concern.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because gravity reads as sober, concerned seriousness.

entries.description: A subdued gaze and gently downturned mouth darken the face with quiet seriousness or sorrow.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because somberness combines subdued seriousness with sorrow.

entries.description: A distant, softened gaze and a small, melancholy smile express gentle longing for something out of reach.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because wistfulness mixes longing with melancholy.

entries.description: The eyes reach toward something distant with raised inner brows while the mouth softens in aching desire.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because longing is shown as aching, unfulfilled desire.

entries.description: An intent, wistful gaze and parted, trembling lips convey deep desire for something absent or unattainable.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because yearning emphasizes the ache of an unfulfilled desire.

entries.description: Soft, wide eyes, raised inner brows, and an unguarded, slightly trembling mouth make the character appear open to hurt.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-sadness-and-distress because vulnerability is conveyed through exposed, fragile emotion.

categories.name: Expressions: Relaxed and Natural
categories.description: Terms and phrases related to expressions: relaxed and natural.

entries.description: Astonishment stretches the eyes wide and drops the jaw, often with sparkling highlights.
A deep red flush covers the face with wide flustered eyes and a mortified grimace.
Red shading concentrates over the nose and inner cheeks like a warm flush.
Glistening strands or drops of drool string from the mouth or the tip of the tongue.
A firm unsmiling face with steady level eyes and a set jaw.
Drooping heavy eyelids, a small open mouth, and a drowsy nodding posture.

For the ahegao portion, use an exaggerated pleasure face with an open mouth and usually rolled-back eyes, often with dilated pupils, tongue out, and raised inner brows; separate o-face and satisfied into their own entries.
A subtle entertained smile with a raised brow and a glint of humor in the eyes.
Pink or red shading spreads across the cheeks, often with small blush lines.
Two bright solid oval blush marks stamped on the cheeks in a stylized cute manner.
A bored look, often with head rest.
An expressionless face; the word also lightens colour.
The lips stay sealed together with no teeth or mouth interior visible.
A puzzled expression with one raised brow, an off-center mouth, and a floating question mark.
Steely focused eyes, a set jaw, and firmly drawn brows project unshakable resolve.
Heavy flushed cheeks, unfocused drooping eyes, and a wobbly swaying posture.
Bright sparkling eyes, a huge open grin, and an energized bouncing posture.
Worn out, often slumped or lying down.
A completely blank face with a level mouth and unremarkable eyes showing no emotion.
A face left undrawn, for background figures; faceless male or faceless female sets the gender.
A hand to the face in dismay.
The face jerks back with shut eyes, raised shoulders, and an alarmed grimace.
A vivid startled fluster with blush, as if caught out.
Narrowed intent eyes lock forward with a set mouth and furrowed concentration.
The whole face flushed red.
The jaw drops so the mouth hangs wide open in shock or awe.
Upturned shining eyes gaze upward with a small expectant smile and lifted brows.
A menacing glare directed at the camera with the head tilted forward, often used to suggest derangement or barely contained volatility.
The tongue tip at the corner of a closed mouth, mischievous.
An unnaturally extended tongue rolls far out past the open mouth.
A mischievous gleam with a sly grin, one raised brow, and scheming eyes.
A nosebleed, with a flustered or blank face and often a bubble.
The lips part to show the inside of the mouth and often the teeth.
A bright hopeful expression with an easy smile and forward-looking shining eyes.
Lost in serious thought, graver than thinking.
Brows lifted into a troubled arch, distinct from furrowed brow.
Soft loose features with a gentle smile, calm half-lidded eyes, and an easy posture.
Tension melts from the face with closed eyes, a loose exhale, and a soft smile.
Averted eyes, a small embarrassed smile, flushed cheeks, and a hand hiding the mouth.
Eyes widen and brows shoot up while the mouth falls open in shock.

entries.term: sweat, blush, closed eyes, open mouth
entries.description: A deeply flushed face with eyes squeezed shut, mouth open, and sweat beading in a heated aroused state.

entries.term: sweat, blush, narrow eyes, open mouth
entries.description: A flushed face with squinting eyes, parted lips, and sweat beads signaling arousal or exertion.
A finger rests against the chin or temple with narrowed eyes gazing upward.
Heavy drooping eyelids, dark under-eye circles, and a slack exhausted expression.
The tongue protrudes past the lips in a playful or panting expression.
The mouth stretches wide open with squeezed eyes and a tilted-back head in tiredness.
A self assured look with a slight smirk and the brows angled down into a confident V.
A smug self satisfied face, chin lifted and eyes half closed above a pleased little smirk.
Wide shining eyes and a parted mouth fixed on a dish, spellbound by the food in front of them.
Wide admiring eyes and an open mouth turned on someone else's muscles.
One brow raised above narrowed distrustful eyes and a flat unconvinced mouth.
The brows, eyes, and mouth rest without a clear emotional pull, creating an even and unbiased facial baseline.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because neutrality provides an unforced resting expression.

entries.description: A quiet, satisfied smile and softly relaxed eyelids show peaceful ease with things as they are.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because contentment reads as peaceful satisfaction.

entries.description: The face looks content and pleased, with relaxed brows, softened eyes, and a small, fulfilled smile.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because satisfaction is expressed as contented ease.
Meaning checked against the e621 satisfied wiki: https://e621.net/wiki_pages/satisfied.

entries.description: The face shows no readable feeling, with still brows, an unfocused or empty gaze, and a level mouth.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural beside expressionless because the face is emptied of emotional display.

entries.description: A steady gaze, level brows, and a firm, unsmiling mouth keep emotion tightly controlled and unreadable.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because stoicism is shown as controlled, impassive restraint.

entries.description: The face remains unmoved, with calm eyes and a settled mouth that reveal no emotional reaction.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because impassivity is an unmoved, neutral facial state.

entries.description: Half-lidded eyes and a flat, relaxed mouth convey a lack of concern or investment.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because indifference appears as an unengaged, neutral face.

entries.description: Dull, heavy-lidded eyes and a slack, expressionless mouth suggest an absence of interest or feeling.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because apathy appears as disengaged emotional flatness.

entries.description: The gaze drifts away and the mouth remains level, making the character appear detached and unengaged.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because disinterest reads as detached neutrality.

entries.description: A flat mouth and half-lidded, steady eyes show that the character sees nothing noteworthy or impressive.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because the expression is a flat, deadpan lack of admiration.
Meaning checked against the e621 unimpressed wiki: https://e621.net/wiki_pages/unimpressed.

entries.description: Soft eyes, a smooth brow, and a faintly lifted mouth create a tranquil, untroubled expression.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because serenity is tranquil calm.

entries.description: The facial muscles loosen into soft eyes and a gentle mouth, with no visible tension or disturbance.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because peacefulness is an untroubled resting state.

entries.description: Even breathing seems to settle the face into steady eyes, relaxed brows, and a composed mouth.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because calm is a settled, relaxed facial state.

entries.description: A still, soft gaze and a gently relaxed mouth give the face deep quiet and ease.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because tranquility is deep, quiet relaxation.

entries.description: The eyes remain steady and the mouth controlled while smooth brows keep the expression poised and self-possessed.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because composure is poised emotional control.

entries.description: Lowered eyelids and a completely relaxed mouth draw attention inward in quiet contemplation.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because meditation appears as inward, relaxed attention.

entries.description: The gaze turns distant beneath softly knitted brows while the mouth rests in thoughtful stillness.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because contemplation is quiet, sustained thought.

entries.description: A reflective gaze, slightly gathered brows, and a relaxed closed mouth show careful consideration.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural beside thinking and pensive because thoughtfulness is quiet reflection.

entries.description: The eyes look inward or into the distance while the mouth softens in quiet reconsideration.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because reflection is quiet, inward thought.

entries.description: Half-lidded, unfocused eyes and a faint, absent smile make the character seem pleasantly lost in imagination.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because dreaminess appears as soft, unfocused reverie.

entries.description: Soft brows, relaxed eyes, and a mild, tender mouth give the face a soothing absence of harshness.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural because gentleness is conveyed through soft, relaxed features.

entries.description: Heavy eyelids, dull eyes, and a slack mouth make the face look emptied of energy.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural beside tired and exhausted because the expression shows depleted energy.

entries.description: The face sags with heavy-lidded eyes and parted, loosened lips after all energy has been used up.
usage_notes: Placed in expressions-relaxed-and-natural beside tired and exhausted because being spent reads as complete fatigue.

A cat mouth curving the opposite way, a cute feline smile facing left instead of right.

One eye winks above an open mouth reaching forward to nibble playfully.
Wide ringed eyes bulge enormously in exaggerated shock, alarm, or comic surprise.
Pointed triangular eyes angled sharply in irritation or feline alertness.

Happily curved closed eyes over a small q shaped mouth with drool at one corner.
Two upward curved closed eyes above a small v shaped smiling mouth.
A flat stylized face built from kana strokes, two curved marks for eyes above a small angular mouth.
Both eyes drawn as X shapes, the comic look of being knocked out or done in.
Eyes squeezed into tight X shapes above a small V shaped frown.

Two round pupilless eyes above a small w shaped cat mouth, wide and delighted.

Mechanical camera-like irises for androids.

Round, enlarged eyes, wide open and comically startled.

Diamond-shaped pupils.
Enlarged pupils, wide-eyed and speechless or unhinged.
Large rounded gentle eyes with soft highlights and an open innocent warmth like a young deer.
Tiny pupils in a pale iris, a cool look.
Eyes rendered with a distinct fold above the lash line, creating a visible crease and layered lid shading.
Outer lid corners pulled downward with heavy lids and dull highlights, reading as exhausted and sorrowful.
Long narrow elegantly drawn eyes with clean lines and a composed aristocratic bearing.
Dead, hollow eyes; weaken character tags if their default eye design overrides it.
Striking unusual eyes with vivid colors or patterns that draw and hold the viewer's attention.
